corrected_content.problem: Find $(3a - 2b) \times c$, if $a \times c = 2i - 3j$ and $b \times c = 5i - 3j$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Use distributivity and factor out the scalars:

$$
\begin{aligned}(3\mathbf a-2\mathbf b)\times\mathbf c&=3(\mathbf a\times\mathbf c)-2(\mathbf b\times\mathbf c)\\&=3(2\mathbf i-3\mathbf j)-2(5\mathbf i-3\mathbf j)\\&=-4\mathbf i-3\mathbf j.\end{aligned}
$$
